profile.reading: This is NSA Texas, located in the Texas Cryptology Center at Lackland Air Force Base in San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, one of several National Security Agency facilities nationwide alongside the agency Fort Meade, Maryland headquarters, the roughly 1.5 billion dollar Utah Data Center at Camp Williams, and the roughly 3.2 billion dollar Site M High Performance Computing Center under construction at Fort Meade. Wikipedia coverage gave only a passing mention of NSA Texas without elaboration on its establishment date, specific purpose, size, or capacity, suggesting it is a smaller installation relative to the Maryland and Utah facilities. As a National Security Agency signals intelligence facility, no commercial capacity, pricing, or colocation information exists for it, and technical specifications are classified rather than simply unpublished.
